title: Queen of the Burning Realm
description: A blonde woman wearing a black crown and red-and-black gown stands on a stone path in a volcanic landscape, holding a chain attached to a naked dark-haired woman lying unconscious at her feet. A giant green alien with purple eyes and the text 'BAD BITCHES' on its forehead looms behind them, its hand resting near the prone woman.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene set in a volcanic wasteland with flowing lava and a burning dark castle in the background under a purple sky. A tall blonde queen in a black and red gown with a spiked crown stands on a stone path, holding a heavy chain. At her feet lies a naked unconscious woman covered in purple flowers and vines. A giant green alien head with large glowing purple eyes and the text BAD BITCHES on its forehead looms behind them, one hand touching the sleeping woman.
